name: MAYBANK
recent: Maybank 近期公告主要是大股东（EPF、PNB、Amanah Saham Bumiputera、KWAP 等）的持股变动申报。公司完成 RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah 发行，并与 ServiceNow 签署五年协议以强化区域银行运营。最新季度净利环比增长 8.5%，但营收同比微降 0.9%。
notable: 完成 RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah 发行。
与 ServiceNow 签署五年协议，以强化区域银行运营。
通过双批次美元债券发行筹集 US$700m。
risks: 多家大股东（EPF、PNB、Amanah Saham Bumiputera、KWAP 等）在 10 月底至 11 月中持续申报持股变动。
股价于 10 月 1 日跌破 RM10，为九个月来首次，报道指债券收益率上升对银行股构成压力。

recent_en: Maybank's recent announcements are mainly substantial shareholder (EPF, PNB, Amanah Saham Bumiputera, KWAP, etc.) interest changes. The company completed a RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance and signed a five-year ServiceNow deal to strengthen regional banking operations. Latest quarter net income rose 8.5% QoQ, while revenue dipped 0.9% YoY.
notable_en: Completed RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance.
Signed a five-year ServiceNow deal to strengthen regional banking operations.
Raised US$700m via a dual-tranche dollar bond sale.
risks_en: Several substantial shareholders (EPF, PNB, Amanah Saham Bumiputera, KWAP, etc.) continued to report changes in interests from late October to mid-November.
Share price fell below RM10 on 1 October for the first time in nine months, with reports citing rising bond yields weighing on banking stocks.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 7,147,201,000, up 2.2% QoQ and down 0.9% YoY; net income was MYR 2,690,362,000, up 8.5% QoQ and 2.4% YoY; net margin was 37.6%, higher than 35.5% in the previous quarter.
